thread:
linda: Heads-up: deploying inference-api v3.3.0 as a staged rollout. Starting at 2% in eu-central, change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood.local/releases/3.3.0

deploy-bot: [deploy] staged rollout started: service=inference-api version=v3.3.0 region=eu-central target=2%. dashboard: https://dash/rollouts/456. Initial health checks green.
ash: saw a tiny p95 uptick right after deploy but back to baseline. what's the escalation path if it gets worse?
linda: rollback rules: immediate rollback if 5xx > 2% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 3x baseline for 5m. soft pause if kvcache_miss > 6% for 8m. also eval smoke suite must pass for new model outputs.
oncall-eu: alert: p95 trending from 110ms -> 190ms at 02:07; p99 still fine. current 5xx=0.2%. snippet: `SERVICE=inference-api TS=2025-01-12T02:07:18Z p95=190ms p99=620ms 5xx=0.2% kvcache_miss=2.1% qps=320`.
chris: that's within soft-threshold but odd that p95 rose without cache miss. could be a background job spike. checking infra events.
dash: infra note: node patch started at 02:05 on eu-central-3 (kernel update), kubelet restarted on some pods. may cause short-term tail latency as caches rebuild.
linda: ok. quick poll: :thumbsup: hold and pin region at 2% until infra confirms healthy; :eyes: continue and monitor. 60s vote.
ach: :eyes: monitor.
chris: :thumbsup: hold.
oncall-eu: :thumbsup: hold. paging infra to confirm node patch details.
linda: consensus to hold. ash please post exact action so deploy-bot can apply pin.
ach: pin action: lock new-traffic to v3.2.9 in eu-central, halt ramp. do not rollback existing 2% traffic; allow current sessions. set auto-rollback threshold to legacy 2% 5xx or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m.
deploy-bot: Action: pause ramp. region eu-central locked to v3.2.9 for new traffic. To rollback run: `/deploy rollback inference-api v3.2.9 --region eu-central`. No rollback executed.
chris: infra update: patch job was a control-plane maintenance that caused kubelet restart on 1 node, pods rescheduled slowly. KV cache warmups expected for ~12min. we'll stagger scheduling to avoid two nodes at once.
oncall-eu: monitoring: p95 trending back down to ~130ms after reschedule. kvcache_miss stayed low.
linda: thanks. plan: keep hold for 20 minutes of stable p95 < 1.5x baseline, then resume to 10% if safe. open follow-up INF-517. I'll update rollout notes and the change window page.
ach: noted. I'll also add a short blurb to release notes about infra sensitivity and recommended warmup policy.
deploy-bot: Rollout state = HELD (2% eu-central). Pin applied.
linda: closing call — state HELD, follow-up INF-517. will reopen thread when we get green for 20m. thanks all :sparkles:
